purpose: Fifth fresh generality batch using frameworks and repositories not covered in batches 1-4: Go net/http (ServeMux method patterns with JSON decode/render helpers and implicit status), PHP Slim 4 (class-based actions behind a response emitter), Spring Boot (annotations in controller source), Next.js App Router (Stripe webhook signature requirement and auth redirects), and Quarkus / Jakarta REST (JAX-RS entity parameters and Response.ok(field).build()). Every project is pinned to a commit, scanned with an empty ledger and no project-specific rules, and expected routes were verified from the route registration source directly.

scoring.notes: All five scored applications are deterministic with zero unresolved gaps. A separate, unscanned-for-score probe (laravelio) is documented in REMAINING-batch5.md: it is a large server-rendered Blade application whose HTML/redirect responses are not JSON API contracts. Wildcard CORS OPTIONS handlers and framework internals are not counted as operations.

projects.baseline: Go team RAG example using Go 1.22 ServeMux method patterns: mux.HandleFunc("POST /add/", ...) and "POST /query/" (2 operations). Bodies are decoded through a readRequestJSON helper that wraps json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode with an application/json guard into function-local structs. /add writes an implicit empty 200 after its 400/500 http.Error branches; /query renders a JSON string through a renderJSON helper (json.Marshal + w.Header().Set + w.Write, implicit 200).

Official Slim 4 skeleton app/routes.php: GET / (text hello world), and a /users group with GET /users (ListUsersAction) and GET /users/{id} (ViewUserAction) (3 operations). The catch-all OPTIONS /{routes:.*} CORS preflight handler is a wildcard and is excluded. Class-based actions emit JSON through the shared Action responder envelope {statusCode,data}.

Spring REST service guide (complete): GreetingController @RestController exposes GET /greeting with an optional @RequestParam(name, defaultValue="World") and returns a Greeting record as JSON (1 operation).

App Router route handlers (3 operations): POST /api/webhooks reads the raw body and the stripe-signature header, returning 400 when the signature/secret is missing or constructEvent fails and a 200 text result on success; GET /auth/callback and GET /auth/reset_password always return NextResponse.redirect(...) which is an empty 307 even though the Location target is computed by a helper.

Quarkus rest-json quickstart (4 operations): FruitResource @Path("/fruits") exposes GET (returns Set<Fruit>), POST and DELETE whose unannotated Fruit parameter is the JAX-RS entity request body and which return Set<Fruit>; LegumeResource @Path("/legumes") exposes GET returning Response.ok(legumes).build(), where legumes is an instance field of type Set<Legume>.
